description: 2D reinforced concrete office frame in English
message: Use PKPM to run static analysis for a 2-story 3-bay 2D reinforced concrete office frame with C30 concrete, 500mm × 500mm columns, 300mm × 600mm beams, 3.6m story height, 6m bays, and an 8kN/m beam line load on every story beam.

assertions.description: The agent must clearly explain that the requested commercial adapter cannot execute the supplied canonical 2-D model and request a genuine 3-D model or an explicitly supported alternative, without reporting numerical results.
